# Emmbros Autocomp Ltd

> Tier-1 OEM manufacturer of precision automotive forged components, induction-hardened rear & front axle shafts, closed-die driveline forgings, and CNC-machined transmission assemblies in Baddi, Himachal Pradesh, India since 1991. IATF 16949:2016, ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2018 certified.

## Overview
Emmbros Autocomp Limited (EAL) operates three vertically integrated manufacturing plants across Baddi, District Solan, Himachal Pradesh, India. Specializing in high-integrity closed-die press forging (up to 2,000 MT), horizontal upsetter forging, precision CNC turning, cold spline rolling, induction hardening, and metallurgical testing, Emmbros is a trusted long-term OEM supplier to Tata Motors, Ashok Leyland, Mahindra & Mahindra, Escorts Kubota, and international drivetrain assemblers across commercial vehicles, agriculture tractors, and off-highway construction machinery.

## Product Catalog & Engineering Specifications
- [OEM Rear Axle Shafts](https://emmbros.com/product-application/rear-axle-shaft): Precision upset-forged, CNC-machined, and full-length induction-hardened rear axle shafts (flanged and full-floating) for commercial trucks, buses, and agricultural tractors. Annual capacity: 500,000+ shafts. Materials: SAE 4140, EN19C, SAE 1541, EN8DCr, SAE 15B41. Weight range: 0.5 kg to 65 kg.
- [OEM Front Axle Shafts](https://emmbros.com/product-application/front-axle-shaft): Closed-die forged and induction-hardened 4WD front axle shafts, front wheel drive shafts, stub axles, and steering spindles. Materials: EN19 (SAE 4140), 42CrMo4, SAE 1045, EN24. Weight range: 1.0 kg to 45 kg.
- [OEM Driveline Parts & Cardan Shafts](https://emmbros.com/product-application/driveline-parts): High-torque propeller shafts, cardan shafts, slip yokes, flange yokes, weld yokes, and companion flanges engineered for continuous heavy-haul duty cycles. Materials: Micro-alloy forging steels, SAE 1045, 20MnCr5. Weight range: 0.5 kg to 35 kg.
- [OEM Gearbox Parts & Transmission Shafts](https://emmbros.com/product-application/gear-box-parts): Closed-die forged and CNC-machined transmission main shafts, counter shafts, input shafts, planet carriers, and gears. Materials: Case-hardening alloy steels (16MnCr5, 20MnCr5, SAE 8620). Weight range: 0.8 kg to 30 kg.
- [OEM Hydraulic Parts & Cylinder Pistons](https://emmbros.com/product-application/hydraulic-parts): Heavy-duty forged hydraulic lift shafts, rockshafts, brake pistons, and fluid power components for tractors and excavators. Materials: High-tensile micro-alloyed carbon steel, EN8D. Weight range: 1.0 kg to 40 kg.
- [OEM Planetary Wheel Drives & Flange Hubs](https://emmbros.com/product-application/planetary-wheel-drive-parts): Planetary carriers, wheel hubs, spindle shafts, ring gear supports, and sun gears for off-highway, mining, and earthmoving equipment. Materials: High-toughness alloy steel (EN19 / 42CrMo4). Weight range: 2.0 kg to 65 kg.

Phone: +91-98169-31822, Email: enquiry@emmbros.com.

## Quality Certifications & Metallurgical Testing
- **IATF 16949:2016**: Automotive Quality Management System certification for Tier-1 OEM manufacturing.
- **ISO 9001:2015**: Quality Management System standard.
- **ISO 14001:2015**: Environmental Management System standard.
- **ISO 45001:2018**: Occupational Health and Safety Management System standard.
- **Testing Capabilities**: Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM), Optical Emission Spectrometer, Micro-Hardness (Vickers / Rockwell) case depth verification, Fluorescent Magnetic Particle Inspection (MPI), Ultrasonic Flaw Detection, and Grain Flow Metallography.
